name: The Barn
description: is a modern British gastropub and sports bar in Canggu, Bali, known for its London-inspired vintage decor, extensive drinks menu, and classic pub fare like Fish & Chips and Sunday Roast. It features live sports shown on multiple screens, bar games like pool and shuffleboard, a sophisticated upstairs cocktail bar, and an air-conditioned interior.
priceRange: Main dishes & drinks ~ Rp 99.000 – Rp 279.000; typical meal + drink ~ Rp 170.000 per person. Starters from ~Rp 59.000, smaller snacks from ~Rp 25.000. :contentReference[oaicite:2]{index=2}
